note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor (authored none of the userns spec commits d8427e4380, b00e3c6710, 68b723ec4f, 7d11a51269). userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-executes the one test in a new user+net+mount namespace and returns false in the parent only after the child's own PASS line; a child failure, a zero-exit failure or a child that selected nothing fails the parent, and a child skip skips it, so the guard cannot turn a red into a green. Section 3.3.4: "In any case, an AH implementation MUST support generation of ICMP PMTU messages (or equivalent internal signaling for native host implementations) to minimize the likelihood of fragmentation." TestAHPathMTUIsSignaledToTheLocalSender changed by the guard only; requireXFRM, pmtuLink and the raw-socket helper now fail on a refused capability instead of skipping (stronger). The unit still requires an unprotected IPV6_MTU larger than the AH header, a drop of at least ahHeaderOctets after the real installer writes the AH state and require-policy (protected >= clear is red), and a return to the clear value after onInterfaceDown. Ze is a transport-mode native host, so the internal-signalling alternative is the one owed; ICMP generation for forwarded traffic is not exercised. Records (buildIPsecPolicies, removeLocked reverts) current.
